headline: Vim HealthTech platform achieves HITRUST r2 certification; leadership transition and clinic expansion underway

signals.summary: Vim's application achieved HITRUST r2 certification, demonstrating enhanced cybersecurity and information protection compliance posture.
signals.suggestedAction: Reach out to congratulate on HITRUST certification and schedule a brief compliance posture review call—position Paubox Email Suite and Inbound Security as complementary protections for their newly certified infrastructure.

headline: Vim HealthTech: Leadership change and revenue growth signal expansion readiness

signals.summary: Vim reported $30.3M estimated ARR for 2025, demonstrating strong growth trajectory and organizational scale-up
signals.suggestedAction: Schedule a business review to discuss whether current Paubox seat allocation aligns with headcount growth; explore if expansion into new functional areas (marketing campaigns, secure forms for patient intake) is now viable.
